summary: Frontend-only verification of the Inertia SPA stale-countdown fix on auction detail pages (artirdim.com). Primary bug is FIXED: SPA navigation between auction A (nav-3h-DUp1C, ~3h left) and auction B (antika-masa-saati-ve-vazo-seti-MD1c, ~5g23s left) now shows each auction's own correct 'Kalan' value across 2 full A->B->A round trips, matches full-page-reload value, and keeps ticking (2 saat 55 dk -> 2 saat 54 dk after 64s) with no console errors and no duplicate/conflicting values (no interval leak). All 3 requested regressions pass: PLANLI page shows 'Başlamasına: 1 gün 23 saat' with zero bid controls; /browse/auctions cards show only AKTİF (no false CANLI); buyer@test.com successfully bid 18.000 TL on auction B (price 17.760 -> 18.000, no error). Note: Auctions/Show has no in-page auction links, so SPA navigation was performed via in-app Inertia links (Profili Gör -> seller profile card -> auction), which still exercises the stale module-state path since auction-show.js stays loaded.

minor.issue: Header search placeholder says 'Müzayede, ilan veya kullanıcı ara...' but SearchController::search only queries users (auction search block is commented out). q=antika/vazo/saat returns [] even though matching active auctions exist -> user sees 'Sonuç bulunamadı'.

ui_bugs.issue: Status badges are wrong: PLANLI auction (planned-HfQfot), ENDED auction (ended-GkyLZi) and DRAFT auction (test-draft-i7Cybz) all render an 'AKTİF' badge. Browse page badges are correct, so the profile card component does not use the same state logic.
Draft (onay bekleyen) auction is listed to a guest (title + price + link visible) even though the detail page correctly returns 404 for guests -> unapproved-listing data leak.
Auction 'Antika Masa Saati ve Vazo Seti' uses an unrelated beer-tap photo; several /browse/auctions card images 404 in console (Failed to load resource: 404).

action_items: Fix status badge computation on public profile auction cards (PLANLI/BİTTİ/DRAFT wrongly shown as AKTİF)
Exclude draft/unapproved auctions from public profile listing for non-owner/non-admin viewers
Either enable auction results in SearchController::search or change the search placeholder to 'Kullanıcı ara'
critical_code_review_comments: auction-show.js _startTimer() correctly re-reads #auctionNewConfigRoot[data-remaining-secs] on every (re)start and __auctionShowInit/__auctionShowCleanup clear timerInt; verified no stale carry-over. Note the module keeps other top-level state (loaded once, never re-imported) - any future per-auction state added there must follow the same re-read-on-init pattern.
Inertia vue3 3.7.0 uses key=Date.now() per non-preserveState visit, so Auctions/Show remounts on every navigation and onMounted->boot() is reliably called; no page key change needed.
seed_data_creation: None. One real bid of 18.000 TL placed on antika-masa-saati-ve-vazo-seti-MD1c by buyer@test.com (regression check).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Countdown Inertia-nav bug verified fixed (iteration 6). To force Show->Show SPA nav there is no direct auction-to-auction link on Auctions/Show; use 'Profili Gör' -> /u/seller -> click auction card (visible-only selectors: a:has-text("Profili Gör"):visible). Bid flow: #bid-input placeholder carries min amount, submit via [data-testid=bid-submit-btn]. Open (unfixed) items: profile card badges, draft leak on profile, search only returns users, seed image mismatches.
rca_of_the_issue: Original bug: remainingSecs was seeded once at module load; after Inertia SPA navigation the module stayed loaded so the timer kept counting auction A's value on auction B. Fix (verified): _startTimer() re-reads the Vue-reactive data-remaining-secs attribute on #auctionNewConfigRoot each start, and __auctionShowCleanup clears the previous interval on unmount. Observed values: A=10567s -> '2 saat 56 dk', B=516614s -> '5 gün 23 saat', alternating correctly over 2 round trips.
